description: Australian Road Deaths Database (ARDD) is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Bureau of Infrastructure and Transport Research Economics. The Australian Road Deaths Database provides basic details of road transport crash fatalities in Australia as reported by the police each month to the State and Territory road safety authorities. Road deaths from recent months are preliminary and the series is subject to revision. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Bureau of Infrastructure and Transport Research Economics. Its tags are Australia, BITRE, Deaths, Road, Road deaths. It offers 4 resource(s) in CSV, PDF. The portal shows 2023-12-11 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
